import sys
from contextlib import contextmanager
from unittest.mock import MagicMock
import sqlite3
sys.path.insert(0, r'token-master-plugin\skills\token-master')
from brainspace.ccr import CCR
store = CCR()
conn = MagicMock()
@contextmanager
def connect():
    yield conn
store._connect = connect
conn.execute.return_value.fetchone.side_effect = [(2, 20, 10, 3), (1, 1)]
base = store.stats()
assert 'evicted_records' not in base
assert conn.execute.call_count == 2
conn.reset_mock()
conn.execute.return_value.fetchone.side_effect = [(2, 20, 10, 3), (1, 1), (7,)]
assert store.stats(include_evictions=True) == dict(base, evicted_records=7)
conn.execute.assert_called_with('SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ccr_evictions WHERE scope=?', (store._scope_key,))
conn.execute.side_effect = sqlite3.OperationalError('unreadable')
fallback = store.stats()
assert 'evicted_records' not in fallback
assert store.stats(include_evictions=True) == dict(fallback, evicted_records=0)
try:
    store.stats(True)
except TypeError:
    pass
else:
    raise AssertionError('parameter must be keyword-only')
print('Focused stats checks passed')
'@ | python -; git --no-pager diff --check; git --no-pager status --short
